title: MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - JURADO) relative to funding to operate and maintain the Madrid Theatre, the Taxco Theater and the Canoga Park Youth Arts Center in…
text:
[Council File 26-1676; CD 3]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - JURADO) relative to funding to operate and maintain the Madrid Theatre, the Taxco Theater and the Canoga Park Youth Arts Center in Council District 3.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the Department of Cultural Affairs (DCA) to establish a new Appropriation Account under Cultural Affairs Department Trust Fund No. 844/30, Account Number TBD, for the Canoga Park Arts Hub.
2. INSTRUCT DCA to accept and deposit funds including donations made specifically for the Canoga Park Arts Hub into the Cultural Affairs Department Trust Fund No. 844/30, Account Number TBD, for Canoga Park Arts Hub activities including improvements, maintenance, community subsidies, events, and programs.
3. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $500,000 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281203 (CD 3 Redevelopment Projects-Services) to the Cultural Affairs Department Trust Fund No. 844/30, Account No. TBD, for operations and maintenance costs associated with the Canoga Park Arts Hub.
4. AUTHORIZE the Department of Cultural Affairs to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
summary: Council would fund operations and upkeep of three Council District 3 arts venues, the Madrid Theatre, Taxco Theater and Canoga Park Youth Arts Center, by setting up a Canoga Park Arts Hub account and moving $500,000 in redevelopment funds into it.

details.action: appropriation for venue operations and maintenance
